description: Every forward stage is contained in every set closed under the theory's definite rules.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage_le_closed.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) {Y : Set α}
  (hY : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Closed Γ Y) (n : ℕ) (p : α) :
  p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Γ n → p ∈ Y
